answer: In PoA, reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocated honest service to accumulate durable EigenTrust centrality. A freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector weight; splitting endorsements among clones cannot amplify trust because reciprocity-weighted transitivity and consensus thresholds suppress unsupported links. Thus ripple, yarrow, and saffron identities alike must earn influence over time to pass consensus.
